title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 44
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 44: the shut east gate, the Levites and the sons of Zadok, and the rules for the priests who minister.

questions.text: Why shall the outer gate of the sanctuary that looks toward the east stay shut?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the gate shall be shut and no man shall enter by it, because Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it.

answers.text: Because Yahweh has entered in by it
Because it faces the rising sun

questions.text: Who may sit in that gate to eat bread before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh, entering and going out by the way of the porch of the gate.

questions.text: What did the prophet do when he saw Yahweh's glory filling Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: He was brought by the way of the north gate before the house, looked, saw Yahweh's glory filling the house, and fell on his face.

answers.text: He covered his eyes with his hands

questions.text: Whom had the house of Israel brought into the sanctuary, so profaning it?
questions.explanation: They had brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in his sanctuary and to profane it.

answers.text: Levites who had gone astray after idols
The sons of Zadok from among Levi
Foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and flesh
Princes of the house of Israel

questions.text: What will the Levites who went astray after their idols still do in the sanctuary?
questions.explanation: They shall be ministers in the sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people.

answers.text: Wear linen turbans in the inner court
Have oversight at the gates of the house

questions.text: Which priests shall come near to Yahweh to minister to him?
questions.explanation: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of the sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray, shall come near to minister to him.

answers.text: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok
Foreigners among the children of Israel

questions.text: What must the priests wear when they enter the gates of the inner court?
questions.explanation: When they enter the gates of the inner court they shall be clothed with linen garments, and no wool shall come on them while they minister.

answers.text: Woollen garments with a wide sash
The same garments as the people
Linen garments, with no wool on them

questions.text: What is said about the hair of the priests' heads?
questions.explanation: They shall not shave their heads or allow their locks to grow long; they shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

answers.text: They shall shave their heads each new moon
They shall only cut off the hair of their heads
They shall let their locks grow long
They shall cover their hair with wool

questions.text: What may no priest drink when he enters the inner court?
questions.explanation: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say is the inheritance and the possession of the priests?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that he is their inheritance and their possession, and that they shall be given no possession in Israel.

answers.text: A tenth of all the grain
